Subject: Intro demo: Redwood Inference — quick sync?

Hi Alex —

Thanks for taking the time earlier this week. Want to get an intro demo scheduled so we can walk through Redwood's serving platform and see where it might map to Acme's inference requirements.

Would Thursday, Jul 22 at 10:00 AM PT work for a 30-45 minute intro demo? Camila (cc'd) is our Solutions Engineer and can join to answer technical questions.

Proposed agenda (short):
- 5m intros
- 15m platform overview (hosting models, Dedicated, Private)
- 10m perf/cost highlights relevant to analytics workloads
- 10m Q&A / next steps

I can send a calendar invite once you confirm the time. Attaching a short agenda PDF.

Thanks,

ben.carter@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0123

Hey Ben —

Thanks for the invite. Quick heads up: I’ll be traveling the week of the 20th and won’t be able to make Jul 22. Also, after chatting with the analytics team, we think an intro demo might be a bit light — would prefer to do a technical deep dive / workshop so we can scope a potential POC (workloads, token budgets, infra constraints).

Let me know if Jul 29 AM can work and what you’d need from us ahead of time.

—Alex

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the note and the context — 90 minutes sounds right for a POC scoping session. I can lead the workshop on Jul 29 at 10:00 AM PT.

Draft workshop agenda (attached as workshop_agenda.docx):
- 0-10m: Intros + goals alignment (your key success criteria)
- 10-30m: Workload deep dive (traffic patterns, seq lengths, KV cache needs)
- 30-60m: Architecture & serving options (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private)
- 60-80m: Cost/latency tradeoffs & quantization guidance
- 80-90m: Next steps / POC proposal & owners

Request from Acme: please have your ML infra and data infra leads join for the workload deep dive. Also, if you have a current cost baseline for token spend that’d be helpful.

I’ll prepare a short demo of our runtime optimizations and bring some sample perf numbers for similar analytics workloads. Marissa — can you take the calendar invite and add the typical Redwood POC checklist?
